en-US.description: Electron desktop coding agent built on the pi agent kernel.
en-US.longDescription: NekoCode Desktop is an Electron desktop coding agent built on the pi agent kernel. It pairs a React 19 renderer with main-process agent sessions, model configuration, terminal, and Git services, and connects to multiple model endpoints; builds are available for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android/iOS.

zh-CN.description: 基于 pi 内核的 Electron 桌面编码 Agent。
zh-CN.longDescription: NekoCode Desktop 是基于 pi 内核的 Electron 桌面编码 Agent。渲染层使用 React 19，主进程内置 Agent 会话、模型配置、终端与 Git 服务，可连接多种模型端点；除 Windows 安装包外，还提供 macOS、Linux 与 Android/iOS 版本。
zh-CN.name: NekoCode Desktop
